2.5 Mr. Bozize's wife, who currently resides in France, has requested the good offices of .
the French authorities. By a letter of 29 October 1990, the President of the National Assembly
informed her that the French foreign service had ascertained that Mr. Bozize was alive and
that he had been transferred to the Kassai prison at Bangui.
